mechanism_narrative: Accelerating GDP growth, as measured by the year-over-year change in GDPC1, signals a strengthening economy that will boost corporate earnings and drive positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: GDPC1 YoY growth accelerates, but SPX posts negative 60-day returns in >40% of instances over any 3-year period.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) of more than 0.5 percentage points over 3 months signals a rapidly weakening labor market, which will pressure consumer spending and drive negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: UNRATE rises > 0.5pp in 3 months, but SPX posts positive 20-day returns in >60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: When the industrial production index (INDPRO) is above its 12-month moving average, it signals a healthy supply-side expansion that will support positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: INDPRO > 12mo MA, but SPX posts negative 20-day returns in >40% of triggered instances over any 2-year period.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is rising and the consumer price index (CPIAUCSL) is also accelerating, it signals a tightening monetary policy that will pressure equity valuations and drive negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: FEDFUNDS and CPIAUCSL both rising, but SPX posts positive 60-day returns in >40% of instances over any 3-year period.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (HOUST) are declining and retail sales (RSAFS) are also weakening, it signals a broad-based demand slowdown that will pressure corporate revenues and drive negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: HOUST and RSAFS both declining, but SPX posts positive 20-day returns in >60% of instances over any 2-year period.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate (UNRATE) is below 4% and payroll employment (PAYEMS) is also accelerating, it signals a tight labor market that will support wage growth and consumer spending, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: UNRATE < 4% and PAYEMS accelerating, but SPX posts negative 60-day returns in >40% of triggered instances over any 3-year period.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is above 5% and the consumer price index (CPIAUCSL) is also above its 12-month moving average, it signals a restrictive monetary policy that will pressure equity valuations and drive negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: FEDFUNDS > 5% and CPIAUCSL > 12mo MA, but SPX posts positive 20-day returns in >60% of triggered instances over any 2-year period.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production (INDPRO) is accelerating and the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is also below 2%, it signals a favorable supply-side environment with easy monetary conditions that will support positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: INDPRO accelerating and FEDFUNDS < 2%, but SPX posts negative 60-day returns in >40% of instances over any 3-year period.
